entries.definition_en:
δυνατέω, -ῶ
 (δυνατός), 
to be able, be powerful, mighty: with inf., Rom.14:4, 2Co.9:8; absol., opposite to ἀσθενῶ 2Co.13:3.†
 (AS)

δυσεντερία, -ας, ἡ, 
 Rec. for δυσεντέριον (which see), Act.28:8.†
 (AS)

εἴκω (obsolete pres.), see: ἔοικα Transcriber note: This form does not occur in Abbott-Smith. It should be on p. 158..
 (AS)

ἐλεήμων, -ον 
 [in LXX chiefly for חַנּוּן ;] 
merciful: Mat.5:7, Heb.2:17.†
 (AS)

ἀκαίρως, adv. 
 (ἄκαιρος, unseasonable), [in LXX: Si 35 (32):4 * ;] 
out of season, unseasonably: opposite to εὐκαίρως (which see), 2Ti.4:2 (cf. Cremer, 740; MM, VGT, see word).† 
 (AS)

ἐν-ισχύω 
 [in LXX for חָזַק, etc. ;] 
to strengthen: in spiritual sense, Luk.22:43; pass., Act.9:19 (Rec. ἐνισχύσεν, became strong, as in LXX, Gen.12:10 48:2, al.).†
 (AS)

ἱλασμός, -οῦ
 (ἱλάσκομαι), [in LXX: Lev.25:9, Num.5:8 (כִּפֻּר), Psa.130:4, Da TH Dan.9:9 (סְלִיחָה), Amo.8:14 (אַשְׁמָה), Eze.44:27 (חַטָּאָה), 1Ch.28:20, Sir.18:20 A, 2Ma.3:33 * ;] 
__1. an appeasing (Plut.). 
 __2. a means of appeasing, propitiation (Philo; Nu, Ez, ll.with): 1Jn.2:2 Jn 4:10. 
 __3. In LXX also forgiveness (Ps, Da TH, ll.with).†
 (AS)

κατόρθωμα, -τος, τό 
 Rec, for διόρθωμα (which see), Act.24:3.†
 (AS)

ἀναβολή, - ῆς, ἡ
 (ά αβάλλω), [in LXX for בּנף, etc. ;] 
delay: Act.25:17 (for exx. of other meanings, see MM, VGT, see word).†
 (AS)

Ματταθά, ὁ 
 indecl. (Heb. מַתַּתָּה), 
 Mattatha: Luk.3:31.†
 (AS)

μεμβράνα, -ας, ἡ (Lat. membrana), 
 parchment: 2Ti.4:13.†
 (AS)

μένω, 
 [in LXX for קוּם ,עמד, etc. ;] 
to stay, abide, remain. 
__1. Intrans.; 
__(i) of place: before ἐν, Luk.8:27, al.; παρά, with dative of person(s), Jhn.1:40, al; σύν, Luk.1:56; καθ᾽ ἑαυτόν, Act.28:16; with adv., ἐκεῖ, Mat.10:11; ὧδε, Mat.26:38; metaphorically, 1Jn.2:18; of the Holy Spirit, Jhn.1:32, 33 14:17; of Christ, Jhn.6:56 15:4, al.; ὁ θεός, 1Jn.4:15, conversely, of Christians, Jhn.6:56 15:4, 1Jn.4:15, al.; ὁ λόγος τ. θεοῦ, 1Jn.2:14; ἡ ἀλήθεια, II Jo 2, al. 
 __(ii) Of time; 
__(a) of persons: Php.1:25; before εἰς τ. αἰῶνα, Jhn.12:34, Heb.7:24, 1Jn.2:17; ὀλίγον, Rev.17:10; ἕως ἔρχομαι, Jhn.21:22, 23; 
 __(b) of things, lasting or enduring: cities, Mat.11:23, Heb.13:14; λόγος θεοῦ, 1Pe.1:23; ἁμαρτία, Jhn.9:41. 
 __(iii) Of condition: with pred., μόνος, Jhn.12:24; ἄγαμος, 1Co.7:11; πιστός, 2Ti.2:13; ἱερεύς, Heb.7:3; with adv., οὕτως, 1Co.7:40; ὡς κἀγώ, ib. 8; before ἐν, ib. 20, 24. 
 __2. Trans. (Bl., §34, 1; Field, Notes, 132): with accusative of person(s), Act.20:5, 23 (cf. ἀνα-, δια-, ἐν-, ἐπι-, κατα-, παρα-, συν-παρα-, περι-, προσ-, ὑπο-μένω). 
 (AS)

περι-ρήγνυμι
 (Rec. -ρρ-, see supr.) [in LXX: 2Ma.4:38 * ;] 
to break or tear off all around: frequently of garments, τ. ἰμάτια, Act.16:22.†
 (AS)

ποικίλος, -η, -ον 
 [in LXX for נָקֹד, רִקְמָה, etc. ;] 
many-coloured, variegated. Metaphorical, various, manifold: Mat.4:24, Mrk.1:34, Luk.4:40, 2Ti.3:6, Tit.3:3, Heb.2:4 13:9, Jas.1:2, 1Pe.1:6 4:10.†
 (AS)

προ-ακούω 
 to hear beforehand: Col.1:5 (see Lft., in l).†
 (AS)

ἄνοιξις, -εως, ἡ
 (ἀνοίγω), 
an opening (in MGr., springtime): ἐν ἀ., as often as I open, Eph.6:19.†
 (AS)

σφάζω 
 [in LXX chiefly for שָׁחַט ;] 
to slay, slaughter (esp. of victims for sacrifice): ἀρνίον, Rev.5:6, 12 13:8; of persons, 1Jn.3:12, Rev.5:9 6:4, 9 18:24; ἐσφαγμένη εἰς θάνατον (RV, smitten unto death), Rev.13:3 (cf. κατα-σφάζω).†
 (AS)

ἀγνοέω, -ῶ (> ἁγνίζω), 
 [in LXX for שָׁגָה, שָׁגַג, אָשַׁם, etc. ;] 
 __1. to be ignorant, not to know: absol., Ι Ti 1:13, Heb.5:2; with accusative, Act.13:27 17:23, Rom.10:3, 2Co.2:11; ἐν οἷς, 2Pe.2:12; before ὅτι, Rom.2:4 6:3 7:1, 1Co.14:38; οὐ θέλω ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν, a Pauline phrase: with accusative, Rom.11:25; before ὑπέρ, 2Co.1:8; περί, 1Co.12:1, 1Th.4:13. ὅτι, Rom.1:13, 1Co.10:1 (for similar usage in π., V. MM, VGT, see word). Pass.: 1Co.14:38, 2Co.6:9, Gal.1:22.
 __2. not to understand: with accusative, Mrk.9:32, Luk.9:45.
 † (AS)

τέλος, -ους, τό 
 [in LXX for קֵץ, etc.; εἰς τὸ τ., chiefly for נֶצַח and cognate forms ;] 
__1. end: most frequently of the termination or limit of an act or state (in NT also of the end of a period of time, cl. τελευτή), Luk.1:33, 1Co.10:11, 2Co.3:13, 1Pe.4:7; by meton., of one who makes an end, Rom.10:4; ἕως (ἄχρι, μέκρι) τέλους, 1Co.1:8, 2Co.1:13, Heb.3:14 6:11, Rev.2:26; εἰς τ., to or at the end, Mat.10:22, Mrk.13:13, Luk.18:5, Jhn.13:1 (or here, to the uttermost, see Westc., in l); τ. ἔχειν, Luk.22:37; adverbially, τὸ δὲ τέλος, finally, 1Pe.3:8; of the last in a series, Rev.21:6 22:13; of the issue, fate or destiny, Mat.26:58; with genitive of thing(s), Rom.6:21, al.; with genitive of person(s), 2Co.11:13, al.; of the aim or purpose, 1Ti.1:5. 
 __2. toll, custom, revenue: Rom.13:7; pl., as most usually, Mat.17:25 
 (AS)

ἀνωτερικός, -ή όν
 (ἀνώτερος) 
upper: Act.19:1.†
 (AS)

φρήν genitive, φρενός, ἡ, 
 [in LXX most frequently in Pr (Pro.6:32, al.) and chiefly for לֵב; also 3Ma.4:16 3Mac 5:47 ;] 
chiefly in Hom. and Trag., but also in Plat., al., both sing. and pl.; 
 __1. in physical sense, the parts about the heart, midriff. 
 __2. heart, mind, thought: pl., 1Co.14:20 (see Edwards, Eng.-Gr. Lex., App., 1).†
 (AS)
